source_title: 13 Celebrity Kids Who Dressed as Their Famous Parents for Halloween - People.com
source_excerpt:
In 2019, Kylie Jenner’s daughter Stormi Webster recreated one of her mom’s iconic Met Gala looks
Gabrielle Union/Instagram; Michael Drummond/ @michaeldrummond/michaeldrummondphoto.com
Over the years, several celebrity kids have found Halloween costume inspiration in the form of their famous moms and dads.
These children — including Viola Davis ’ daughter Genesis Tennon and Nick Cannon ’s son Golden Sagon Cannon — have turned to their family photo albums, red carpet moments and even some of their parents’ most iconic career looks for inspiration. The result? Some seriously impressive mini-me moments.
From Kylie Jenner ’s daughter Stormi Webster absolutely nailing her mom’s Met Gala look to Justin and Hailey Bieber ’s son Jack recreating his “ One Less Lonely Girl ” era, these celebrity kids will have you doing a serious double take.
Here are 13 celebrity kids who dressed like their famous parents for Halloween.
Owen Sweeney/Shutterstock; Hailey Bieber/Instagram
Justin’s son Jack channeled his famous dad for Halloween in 2025. The toddler recreated his father’s early-career “One Less Lonely Girl” era, wearing an all-white denim look with a purple hoodie.
Hailey Bieber shared the costume on Instagram with the caption, “Happy Halloween from JJB 🎃🎃🎃💜.”
Michael Drummond/@michaeldrummond/michaeldrummondphoto.com
Ciara’ s daughter Sienna Wilson went as her mom for Halloween in 2024, replicating her mom’s Out of This World Tour look. She wore red cargo pants, a matching zip-up top, Nike sneakers and a large crown, along with a long blonde wig.
Ciara shared photos of the mother-daughter duo in their matching looks, writing on Instagram , “I asked SiSi who she wanted to be for Halloween and she said me!” She added, “Lil SiSi as Big CiCi.”
United Artists/Sunset Boulevard/Corbis via Getty; JB Lacroix/WireImage
Scott Eastwood paid tribute to his famous father for Halloween in 2016 by dressing as one of Clint Eastwood ’s most iconic characters, Blondie from The Good, the Bad and the Ugly .
He donned the attire for Seth Rogen ’s Hilarity for Charity event , which raised over $1.6 million to help families who require Alzheimer’s care, per the organization .
Karwai Tang/Getty; Kylie Jenner/Instagram
Kylie and Stormi took “like mother, like daughter” literally for Halloween in 2019.
Kylie dressed her daughter in a miniature recreation of the purple feathered Versace gown she wore to that year’s Met Gala, complete with a lavender wig and tiny silver purse.
The Kylie Cosmetics mogul shared photos of the look on Instagram , captioning them, “My baby!!!!!!!!” followed by a string of purple heart emojis. She added, “I [can’t] handle this!!!!”
Michael Kovac/Getty; Viola Davis/Facebook
Viola’s daughter, Genesis, decided to dress as her mom for Halloween in 2015. She recreated Davis’ Emmy look from that year, wearing a white dress similar to her mother’s Carmen Marc Valvo gown and holding a gilded statuette.
Davis shared the sweet photo on Facebook , explaining that Genesis had rejected several other costume ideas before declaring, “I just want to be YOU mommy!”
Saved by the Bell/YouTube; Mario Lopez/Instagram
Mario Lopez ’s younger son, Santino , channeled his dad’s most famous TV character for Halloween in 2019.
Along with his siblings, Santino dressed as his father’s Saved by the Bell character, with the then-3-month-old sporting an A.C. Slater-inspired look. Mario shared the family costumes on Instagram with the caption, “Saved By The Bell the reboot!”
Busy’s daughter Birdie took some inspiration from her mom for Halloween in 2017.
She recreated one of Busy’s signature everyday looks , wearing a boho-style floral dress, statement earrings, sunglasses and carrying an iced coffee. The actress joked on her Instagram Stories that Birdie was “making fun of me,” but said she was “gonna start to cry” as her daughter’s costume choice was “so sweet.”
Morgan Wallen’ s son, Indigo Wilder , dressed as his country-star dad for his first Halloween in 2020. The then-3-month-old wore jeans, a red button-up shirt with the sleeves cut off and a gray hat topped with a faux version of his dad’s signature long hair.
Indigo’s mom, KT Smith , shared the photo on Instagram , writing, “My tea is sweet but honey you’re sweeter 🤣 Happy Halloween from lil Indie Wilder.”
Kaavia James Union Wade and her mom, Gabrielle Union , brought back one of Union’s most famous movie looks for Halloween 2019.
The pair dressed as Union’s Bring It On character, Isis, in matching East Compton Clovers cheerleading uniforms. Union shared photos of their twinning looks on Instagram with the caption, “Brought It. #CaliforniaLove.”
Lil Pump/YouTube; Kourtney Kardashian/Instagram
Saint West paid tribute to his dad Kanye West for Halloween in 2018 by recreating his oversized look from the “I Love It” music video with Lil Pump . Saint wore a tiny version of Kanye’s boxy padded outfit, complete with oversized shoes.
Kourtney Kardashian shared photos of Saint and his cousin Reign Disick , who dressed as Lil Pump, on Instagram . Kourtney’s caption simply read, “i love it.”
Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi ’s daughter Giovanna looked like a mini version of her mom for Halloween in 2019. She wore a leopard-print top and leggings, sunglasses and Snooki’s signature poof hairstyle, recreating her mom’s unmistakable Jersey Shore aesthetic.
“MAWMA,” Polizzi captioned the photo on Instagram before clarifying, “This is not her official costume.”
Brian Stukes/Getty; Nick Cannon/Instagram
Nick’s son Golden Sagon went as his dad for Halloween in 2022. The 5-year-old recreated Nick’s signature Wild ’N Out look with a Wild ’N Out T-shirt, gold sneakers, sunglasses, tattoos and a microphone.
Nick shared the photo on Instagram , writing, “The best ‘Nick Cannon’ costume I’ve seen this year!!” He added, “Chip off the old block! The Golden Child!”
The Real Housewives of Dallas star Kameron Westcott ’s daughter, Hilton, went as her stylish mom for Halloween in 2019. She recreated Kameron’s look with a pink furry vest, round sunglasses, a white top and pink bottoms.
Kameron shared a photo of the matching mother-daughter looks on Instagram , writing, “For Halloween we dress as each other ?? My FAB mini-me in PINK!!”
